subject.title: feat(comfy): dynamic aspect ratio → width/height injection

question: Should image-generation capability reporting become configuration-aware so Comfy can advertise size and aspect-ratio support only when its workflow has dimension nodes mapped?
rationale: A static false value prevents configured Comfy workflows from receiving geometry, while a static true value misrepresents unconfigured workflows; choosing the durable shared capability contract requires owner intent rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Add config-aware capabilities
options.body: Extend the shared provider contract and all listing/normalization callers so capability support is resolved from active configuration before accepting geometry overrides.

options.title: Keep capabilities static
options.body: Merge unconditional support and intentionally accept that unconfigured Comfy workflows classify ignored geometry requests as supported.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep Comfy capabilities false until maintainers are ready to introduce a configuration-aware contract that represents the behavior accurately.

recommendation.title: Add config-aware capabilities
recommendation.body: Extend the shared provider contract and all listing/normalization callers so capability support is resolved from active configuration before accepting geometry overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the Comfy capability-configuration resolver and schema boundary affected by this decision.
